verses.en: Why do the heathen rage, and the people imagine a vain thing?
verses.pt: Por que se amotinam as nações, e os povos tramam em vão?
verses.en_web: Why do the nations rage, and the peoples plot a vain thing?
verses.en_bbe: Why are the nations so violently moved, and why are the thoughts of the people so foolish?

verses.en: The kings of the earth set themselves, and the rulers take counsel together, against the LORD, and against his anointed, saying,
verses.pt: Os reis da terra se levantam, e os príncipes juntos conspiram contra o Senhor e contra o seu ungido, dizendo:
verses.en_web: The kings of the earth take a stand, and the rulers take counsel together, against Yahweh, and against his Anointed, saying,
verses.en_bbe: The kings of the earth have taken their place, and the rulers are fixed in their purpose, against the Lord, and against the king of his selection, saying,

verses.en: Let us break their bands asunder, and cast away their cords from us.
verses.pt: Rompamos as suas ataduras, e sacudamos de nós as suas cordas.
verses.en_web: “Let’s break their bonds apart, and cast their cords from us.”
verses.en_bbe: Let their chains be broken, and their cords taken from off us.

verses.en: He that sitteth in the heavens shall laugh: the Lord shall have them in derision.
verses.pt: Aquele que está sentado nos céus se rirá; o Senhor zombará deles.
verses.en_web: He who sits in the heavens will laugh. The Lord will have them in derision.
verses.en_bbe: Then he whose seat is in the heavens will be laughing: the Lord will make sport of them.

verses.en: Then shall he speak unto them in his wrath, and vex them in his sore displeasure.
verses.pt: Então lhes falará na sua ira, e no seu furor os confundirá, dizendo:
verses.en_web: Then he will speak to them in his anger, and terrify them in his wrath:
verses.en_bbe: Then will his angry words come to their ears, and by his wrath they will be troubled:

verses.en: Yet have I set my king upon my holy hill of Zion.
verses.pt: Eu tenho estabelecido o meu Rei sobre Sião, meu santo monte.
verses.en_web: “Yet I have set my King on my holy hill of Zion.”
verses.en_bbe: But I have put my king on my holy hill of Zion.

verses.en: I will declare the decree: the LORD hath said unto me, Thou art my Son; this day have I begotten thee.
verses.pt: Falarei do decreto do Senhor; ele me disse: Tu és meu Filho, hoje te gerei.
verses.en_web: I will tell of the decree. Yahweh said to me, “You are my son. Today I have become your father.
verses.en_bbe: I will make clear the Lord's decision: he has said to me, You are my son, this day have I given you being.

verses.en: Ask of me, and I shall give thee the heathen for thine inheritance, and the uttermost parts of the earth for thy possession.
verses.pt: Pede-me, e eu te darei as nações por herança, e as extremidades da terra por possessão.
verses.en_web: Ask of me, and I will give the nations for your inheritance, the uttermost parts of the earth for your possession.
verses.en_bbe: Make your request to me, and I will give you the nations for your heritage, and the farthest limits of the earth will be under your hand.

verses.en: Thou shalt break them with a rod of iron; thou shalt dash them in pieces like a potter’s vessel.
verses.pt: Tu os quebrarás com uma vara de ferro; tu os despedaçarás como a um vaso de oleiro.
verses.en_web: You shall break them with a rod of iron. You shall dash them in pieces like a potter’s vessel.”
verses.en_bbe: They will be ruled by you with a rod of iron; they will be broken like a potter's vessel.

verses.en: Be wise now therefore, O ye kings: be instructed, ye judges of the earth.
verses.pt: Agora, pois, ó reis, sede prudentes; deixai-vos instruir, juízes da terra.
verses.en_web: Now therefore be wise, you kings. Be instructed, you judges of the earth.
verses.en_bbe: So now be wise, you kings: take his teaching, you judges of the earth.

verses.en: Serve the LORD with fear, and rejoice with trembling.
verses.pt: Servi ao Senhor com temor, e regozijai-vos com tremor.
verses.en_web: Serve Yahweh with fear, and rejoice with trembling.
verses.en_bbe: Give worship to the Lord with fear, kissing his feet and giving him honour,

verses.en: Kiss the Son, lest he be angry, and ye perish from the way, when his wrath is kindled but a little. Blessed are all they that put their trust in him.
verses.pt: Beijai o Filho, para que não se ire, e pereçais no caminho; porque em breve se inflamará a sua ira. Bem-aventurados todos aqueles que nele confiam.
verses.en_web: Give sincere homage to the Son, lest he be angry, and you perish on the way, for his wrath will soon be kindled. Blessed are all those who take refuge in him.
verses.en_bbe: For fear that he may be angry, causing destruction to come on you, because he is quickly moved to wrath. Happy are all those who put their faith in him.
